text:
amir.partnerships: Heads up: NimbusAI reached out to list in APAC-N1 (singapore-south). They want a phased rollout: hosted marketplace first, then Dedicated after 6 weeks. Target initial go-live 2026-06-15. Need gateway quota and marketplace entitlement.

nina.ops: I'll take gateway quota. Requesting 300 qps initially, with auto-scale to 800 qps via marketplace burst. Need partner gateway origin IPs and merchant ID.

carlos.cloudeng: For dedicated capacity, we should recommend 6xA100 reserved. Also, we should prepare a quantized fallback for the hosted path to reduce token costs. Who owns the pricing SKU?

katie.legal: For SG region, please make sure we have Singpass export control checks and DPA plus cross-border data flow note. If partner wants CMKs in SG, confirm they have KMS tenancy in that region.

amir.partnerships: @nina.ops please get gateway IPs and merchant id from partner by EOD. I'll work with Marketing for joint blog copy. Also partner asked for a short co-hosted webinar in the week after launch.

nina.ops: on it. Also requesting vendor to provide vendor quota reference: e.g., "NIM-QUOTA-3344" so we can open with cloud provider.

carlos.cloudeng: Creating infra preflight: canary model load test scheduled 2026-06-08. Request partner provide sample traffic pattern. comm-bot, schedule run.

comm-bot: [automated] scheduled canary test: canary-2306-nimbus-sg1 at 2026-06-08T03:00Z. Notifying eng-oncall and platform team.

katie.legal: Also will need to confirm the partner's corporate entity matches merchant account. Share merchant screenshots with legal.

amir.partnerships: After EOD update we'll collect action items. Nina, Carlos, can you prepare fallback plan and timeline for Dedicated conversion? Marketing asked for 4 business days to review announcement.

nina.ops: Partner sent merchant id NIM-MERCH-3344 and gateway IP block 18.51.0.0/16. Opening quota ticket: https://internal.redwood/ops/quotas/TKT-10123

carlos.cloudeng: Noted. Quantized fallback will be staged in SG and tested during canary. I added a note to the runbook: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/sg1-fallback-quantized.md

katie.legal: DPA + export attestation requested from partner. Sending templates now. Reference LEG-4550.

amir.partnerships: Great. Timeline: quota ticket by 2026-06-03, signed DPA by 2026-06-07, canary 2026-06-08, marketplace SKU verified 2026-06-12, go-live 2026-06-15. We'll keep the thread updated. :white_check_mark:
